avis.titre: Cosed comedones, blackheads, and ingrown hairs
avis.texte: I really wanted to like this product, but unfortunately, it did not work for my skin at all. After applying it to my face, I started developing closed comedones and blackheads. I also tried using it on my legs, and it caused ingrown hairs in areas that were previously clear. After checking the ingredients, I realized it contains Ethylhexyl Stearate and Glyceryl Stearate, which are known to be comedogenic. These ingredients seem to have clogged my pores and sealed in debris, causing irritation and breakouts. If you're acne-prone or prone to ingrown hairs, I'd recommend avoiding this product, especially on areas you shave or exfoliate. Definitely not repurchasing.
